GitHub mitcad/Mitcad#557 (mitcad#2279; opened with --open, never committed; tools/cli/fillet-exact-reported-test.cmake): a profile extruded 25 (Body1, F2.b0), one corner of its side face F2:side(c18[c16,c1]) cut off at a slant through all by Extrude2 (F4). Fillet1 (F6) rounds the side face's two edges, one with the slanted cut face, one with the extrusion's end cap, with a radius typed by hand (11.4704). As a Full Round the radius is worked out from the three faces: the circle touching the end cap (at a right angle), the side face and the cut face (at 131.13 degrees) has radius 11.4696131 (the side face 16.6804 wide between its edges); both roundings meet on the side face, which is gone, its names on the rounding.
A cylinder of the worked-out radius; the side face's name on the rounding.

The volume: the profile (2608.88625 mm2) times 25, less the cut's triangle (39.62 mm2) times the side face's height 29.2334, less the two roundings' corners (r^2 (1 - pi / 4) at the end cap, r^2 (cot(theta / 2) - (pi - theta) / 2) at the cut face, theta = 131.134 degrees) times that height, integrated in the section.
